description: Search Indian food data (IFCT 2017 raw ingredients + INDB cooked dishes) and their per-100g nutrition. Use this to find a food_code before logging a meal so calories are database-accurate for Indian food, not estimated. INDB results are cooked dishes and include a serving size. Returns code, name, group, source, per-100g cal/protein/carb/fat/fiber, and serving (when known). Prefer the result that matches how the food was prepared (cooked dish over raw ingredient; a tempered/fried version over a plain one). If the top result looks off, search again with a more specific phrase before settling.

query.description: Food to search, e.g. "rice raw milled" or "wheat flour".

name: search_food
title: Search Indian foods (IFCT 2017 + INDB)
